# WhatsApp agent case study

> Anonymised case study: a 15-agent WhatsApp and Telegram operations platform for a real-estate brokerage; single-writer SQLite spine, owner-approved follow-ups, -91% heartbeat tokens.

Sanitised public showcase by Dr. Ravi Teja Thiriveedhi (clinician turned AI systems architect). Scope and limits: [TRUST.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/whatsapp-agent-case-study/blob/main/TRUST.md).

## Docs

- [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/whatsapp-agent-case-study/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Data flow and single-writer spine
- [docs/human-in-charge.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/whatsapp-agent-case-study/blob/main/docs/human-in-charge.md): Policy, approvals, takeover, undo
- [docs/agents-and-cost.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/whatsapp-agent-case-study/blob/main/docs/agents-and-cost.md): 15 agents on 3 model tiers
- [docs/lessons.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/whatsapp-agent-case-study/blob/main/docs/lessons.md): Lessons from 129 bugs
- [docs/timeline.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/whatsapp-agent-case-study/blob/main/docs/timeline.md): From first commit to live platform
